name: Lube oil system: pumps, filters, coolers, sump
description: Lube oil system: pumps, filters, coolers, sump | Lube-oil storage, transfer, filtration and make-up

specifications.basis: Jenbacher Type 6 containerised solution, usual scope of supply; alongside container ventilation, cooling systems and control panel/gas train
Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual section 3.2.1
specifications.value: mono-grade SAE 40 (most Cummins lean-burn gas gensets); never use diesel engine oil in a natural gas engine

specifications.metric: Service (day) tank base elevation above floor for gravity feed
specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual section 3.2.3: tank base between 1 and 4 m above floor level for adequate gravity feed to engine sump

Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual section 3.2.4.2: design not specified but tank must contain a minimum of 100 liters; total capacity depends on expected running hours and genset datasheet oil consumption

specifications.metric: Make-up tank connection pipe internal diameter
specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual section 3.2.4.2: make-up tank mounted away from engine, connected by suitable pipework of at least 3/4 inch I.D.
Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual section 3.2.3
specifications.value: pickled or cold-drawn pickled pipe; strainer and foot valve on storage tank suction; solenoid valve if service tank lower than storage tank to prevent siphon overfill

specifications.metric: Lubrication system in common plant architecture
specifications.basis: Schneider Electric White Paper 286, Figure 5 'A high-level presentation of the power plant components'
specifications.value: Lubrication System listed among power-plant common systems (alongside gas piping/pressure reduction, gas storage, electrical distribution, control, fire detection)

gaps.what: Sump capacity, oil pump flow/pressure, filter micron ratings and cooler duty
gaps.why: Not published on the fetched pages
